data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 extrapolates that Rule 54 will fail for W=7. However, Rule 54 is symmetric under left-right reflection, and on an odd-width ring (W=7) this symmetry forces every initial state to be mapped to its mirror image after one step. A state reaching its mirror image in 1 step is constrained to a cycle of length at most 2. Thus, predicting a failure for W=7 contradicts the actual dynamics of Rule 54 on odd rings.
